title: Junior Change Enablement Analyst
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Job Overview**
The Junior Change Enablement Analyst supports technology adoption, learning, communications, community engagement, and responsible-use initiatives. The role helps employees understand approved technology capabilities and apply them to practical business scenarios through structured learning, demonstrations, content, and measurement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Assist with execution of technology enablement, literacy, adoption, and community programs.
* Coordinate workshops, demonstrations, office hours, training sessions, webinars, and community events.
* Create and maintain user guides, quick references, FAQs, presentations, videos, exercises, and knowledge articles.
* Test approved technology tools, features, workflows, and use cases and record structured findings.
* Gather user feedback and document recommendations for learning or product improvements.
* Maintain learning libraries, Teams communities, SharePoint sites, and communication channels.
* Support hands-on exercises and role-based learning programs.
* Track participation, completion, adoption, satisfaction, feedback, and approved program measures.
* Prepare progress reports and presentations for Change Enablement and Technology leadership.
* Support awareness programs on responsible technology use, data protection, information security, ethics, risk, and governance.
* Assist employees with basic questions about approved technology tools and learning resources.
* Promote reusable resources, practical use cases, lessons learned, and responsible practices.
* Support business teams in designing, developing, and adopting technology-enabled solutions using approved low-code and other enterprise tools.

**Essential Job Functions**
Training and Content Development
  
  

* Create structured learning content for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Convert concepts into examples, exercises, and practical job aids.
* Maintain content currency through approved governance and review processes.

Workshop and Community Support
  
  

* Coordinate agendas, invitations, resources, facilitators, attendance, demonstrations, and feedback.
* Capture questions, actions, lessons, and improvement opportunities.

Adoption Measurement
  
  

* Maintain training and adoption trackers.
* Summarize feedback and approved usage information.
* Prepare clear progress updates, visual reports, and recommendations.

Responsible Technology Use Awareness
  
  

* Reinforce approved safe-use practices.
* Route privacy, security, legal, and governance questions to appropriate subject matter experts.
* Avoid presenting unapproved tools or practices as organizational standards.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, Communications, Education, Learning and Development, Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 0 to 2 years of relevant experience, including internships, volunteer programs, academic projects, facilitation, communications, training, or technology-adoption activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, coordination, documentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to explain basic technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 applications.
* Interest in digital adoption, learning, emerging technologies, and organizational change.

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to enterprise technology platforms, collaboration tools, low-code solutions, or digital productivity applications.
* Familiarity with instructional design, adult-learning principles, change management, or user adoption.
* Experience creating presentations, tutorials, knowledge articles, or internal communications.
* Exposure to SharePoint, Teams, Forms, Stream, Power BI, or learning-management systems.
* Awareness of surveys, feedback analysis, adoption metrics, technology ethics, privacy, security, copyright, and governance.

Mandatory Pre-Joining Technology Training
  
  
Selected candidates must complete the assigned role-specific learning plan, hands-on exercises, knowledge checks, and readiness assessment before joining or deployment.
  
  

* Enterprise technology fundamentals and approved business use cases
* Approved productivity, collaboration, and enterprise technology tools
* Effective use and evaluation of technology-enabled workflows
* Responsible technology use, security, privacy, ethics, and governance
* Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Forms, Stream, and PowerPoint
* Low-code platform and workflow automation fundamentals
* Training-needs analysis and audience segmentation
* Adult learning, instructional design, and content-development fundamentals
* Workshop planning, facilitation, demonstration, and storytelling
* Change management and technology-adoption fundamentals
* Survey design, feedback collection, Excel, and Power BI for adoption reporting
* Knowledge management, content governance, Agile, and Azure DevOps fundamentals

Pre-Joining Capstone
  
  
Create a technology enablement plan with a workshop deck, facilitator guide, participant exercise, responsible-use guidance, communication plan, and adoption-measurement approach.
  
  
We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: System Engineer
description:
**About the Company:**

Olympus Corporation is a globally renowned leader in endoscopy enabled healthcare, pioneering innovative solutions that enhance people's lives every day. With a rich history spanning nearly a century, Olympus has continuously pushed the boundaries of what's possible in the realms of medical, scientific, and imaging technology.

This is an incredibly exciting time to join Olympus as we embark on a strategic journey to establish a core R&D presence in India, a hub for cutting-edge development. Our mission is to push the frontiers of technology and innovation, shaping impactful solutions in the fields of endoscopy, microscopy, life sciences, and digital imaging. This opportunity offers highly motivated professionals the chance to work on pioneering projects, driving breakthroughs that will shape the future of technology and healthcare. Join us, grow in tech and digital fields, and be part of a transformative team dedicated to delivering world-class outcomes.

**Purpose of the Role:**

The Systems Engineer will contribute to the design, development, and integration of complex medical devices, working across various engineering disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, software, and embedded systems. The Systems Engineer will be responsible for ensuring the seamless integration of subsystems, managing system-level requirements, and supporting verification and validation activities. The role requires a solid understanding of medical device development processes, regulatory standards, and the ability to work collaboratively within a cross-functional team environment.

This position will take ownership of project delivery both internal and external, ensuring high-quality engineering outcomes and adherence to regulatory standards such as FDA Design Controls. While contributing to project planning, the focus will be on executing technical initiatives and ensuring alignment with the overall project goals. The role requires proactive liaison with internal teams and external partners to maintain seamless coordination and ensure the timely achievement of project milestones.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**NPD and Stakeholder Management:**

* Support the design and development of system architectures for medical devices, ensuring that all subsystems (mechanical, electrical, software, and embedded systems) are well-integrated.
* Define system requirements and specifications based on user needs, regulatory requirements, and design inputs.
* Create and maintain system models and documentation (e.g., block diagrams, interface definitions, and design specifications) to guide product development.
* Support the full systems engineering lifecycle: requirements definition, system architecture, risk management, design, verification, validation, and release.
* Manage systems requirements, traceability, and change management to ensure clear documentation and compliance with design controls.
* Support in the implementation of advanced systems engineering techniques, such as requirements management, system modeling, simulation, and validation to drive high performance and reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (mechanical, software, hardware engineers) to ensure seamless integration of designs into overall product architecture and meet system-level requirements.
* Support the development and execution of system-level verification and validation (V&V) plans to ensure the product meets performance, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in test planning, execution, and analysis, including functional testing, performance testing, and risk management evaluations.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in systems engineering and medical device development.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by suggesting new tools, methods, and processes for better systems integration and design efficiency.

**Regulatory & Compliance:**

* Support the Associate Director in ensuring product development aligns with regulatory and industry standards, including FDA, CE, ISO, and other relevant certifications
* Assist in engaging with external teams and certification bodies to ensure compliance with applicable safety standards
* Assis tin the implementation of rigorous risk management processes, including hazard analysis, fault tree analysis (FTA), and failure modes and effects analysis (FMEA)
* Help maintain documentation in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and quality system regulations.

**Why work at Olympus?**

At Olympus, we are committed to fostering a high-performing culture, a collaborative environment, and empowering everyone to shine. Our shared values—integrity,
**empathy, long-term view, agility, and unity—form**
the foundation of our culture and guide our behavior. These values ensure that our people feel they are making a meaningful difference every single day.

**What we are looking for:**

**Education:**

* A degree or higher qualification in Biomedical / System Engineering from a recognized university.
* Masters in biomedical /System engineering will be an added advantage.

**Experience:**

* 4-6 years of experience in System Engineering R&D in the medical devices domain, with a mix of technical and managerial responsibilities
* Proven experience in collaborating with PMOs and global teams on system projects
* Strong technical background in system design, circuit board development, and compliance with regulatory standards
* Experience in medical device development is preferred.

**Skills**

* Strong technical expertise in systems engineering, systems modeling, and requirements management, with hands-on experience in R&D and/or sustaining engineering, especially in product development environments
* Expertise in systems engineering methodologies, including requirements management, risk analysis, and system integration
* Familiarity with medical device product lifecycle management, with experience in applying FDA Design Controls and international standards (e.g., 820-CFR, ISO14971, IEC60601), ensuring compliance with project-specific regulations
* Experience with model-based systems engineering (MBSE) tools and methodologies
* Comfortable working in Agile SCRUM and stage-gate environments, ensuring collaboration with cross-functional teams to meet project objectives
* Ability to develop and contribute to design documentation, including requirements specifications, risk management files, and compliance records for manufacturability and quality assurance
* Knowledge of systems integration and architecture, contributing to design solutions to mitigate risks
* Understanding of software lifecycle management (e.g., EN62304) and experience with managing system-level risks and verification
* Experience with requirements management systems (e.g., DOORS, JAMA), contributing to risk analysis and DFMEA processes in system R&D projects
* Effective stakeholder management skills, collaborating with PMO teams to ensure technical alignment and timely project delivery
* Experience working with project data, contributing to technical assessments and identifying opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiency
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical updates and information clearly to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

**Apply Now:**

To submit your interest in this opportunity, select "Apply for this job."

**Want to know more?**

Confidential discussions are welcome; contact our TA Partner.

***Olympus is an Equal Opportunity Employer.***

"We are deeply committed to fostering a respectful, fair, and welcoming workplace for all individuals, perspectives, and lifestyles. We believe in fostering a nondiscriminatory, inclusive work environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging, in full compliance with legal standards. Empathy and unity are core to our company culture, empowering employees to contribute fully and flourish. We warmly encourage all who wish to bring their talents to Olympus to apply."

**C. Duty Statements and 5 Performance Standards**

Project master data and reporting setup

1. Create the project master from the approved brief, store list and scope; assign unique project and store identifiers and map client, location, vendor or internal team, planned dates and deliverables.
2. Agree report templates, status definitions, mandatory fields, evidence requirements, submission frequency and distribution with Operations, Client Servicing and the client.

4. Performance standards: Set up the tracker before field reporting starts; map 100% of assigned stores without duplicate identifiers; use only approved scope revisions; record every authorised change with its date and source.

**D. Collection and validation of field updates**

1. Obtain daily updates from vendors and Brandola personnel using standard forms or approved reporting systems; follow up missing, late or incomplete submissions.
2. Check store identity, activity date, quantities, dimensions, remarks and photographs against the brief and reporting checklist; identify duplicate, mismatched or unclear evidence.
3. Reconcile conflicting updates with the responsible field owner; label unverified information clearly and maintain a record of corrections.
4. Performance standards: Check 100% of received submissions before client issue; target at least 98% accuracy in mandatory report fields; log all missing inputs by the reporting cut-off and escalate overdue inputs the same working day. Never present unverified work as verified completion.

**E. Recce reports and technical information coordination :**

1. Compile store-wise recce reports covering measurements, site conditions, photographs, branding positions, access restrictions, installation constraints and other client-required information.
2. Check completeness and internal consistency; obtain missing details through Operations and route technical uncertainties to Design or the authorised technical owner.
3. Maintain the recce submission and approval tracker, including client comments, clarifications, revisions and handover of approved information for execution.
4. Performance standards: Submit complete recce packs within the agreed client timeline after validated inputs are received; include every mandatory field or an explicit exception; obtain authorised technical clarification before treating disputed measurements or specifications as final.
5. Installation progress and completion reportingMaintain store-wise planned, completed, pending, on-hold, rework and cancelled status using agreed definitions; record actual dates, installed quantities and balance scope.
6. Compile before-and-after photographs, installation checklists, site acknowledgements and other required completion evidence; distinguish field completion, internal verification and client acceptance.
7. Reconcile daily and cumulative totals by project, region and vendor or internal team; release approved progress reports and completion packs through the agreed channel.
8. Performance standards: Issue all scheduled reports by the agreed cut-off; reconcile store and quantity totals before issue; record completion only against the agreed evidence checklist; show acceptance and pending documentation separately.

**F. Duty Statements and Performance Standards Continued :**

1. Present clear daily, weekly and milestone reports; explain progress, pending work, data limitations and exceptions factually.
2. Acknowledge reporting queries, coordinate verified responses with Operations and Client Servicing, and record client comments and agreed reporting actions.
3. Participate in client reviews when assigned; circulate minutes and update action trackers. Obtain approval before communicating changed delivery dates, scope or commercial commitments.
4. Performance standards: Acknowledge queries within four working hours during agreed service hours; provide a verified response or committed response time within one working day, unless a different client requirement applies; circulate meeting actions within one working day.

**G. Exception tracking and closure follow-up :**

1. Maintain an exception register for inaccessible stores, permission issues, missing data, delays, damaged materials, rejected work, rework and client observations.
2. Assign each exception to the responsible Operations, vendor, Design or Client Servicing owner with a target closure date; track ageing and follow up until supported closure.
3. Flag critical delivery risks immediately to the responsible manager and communicate approved client updates; verify closure evidence before changing status.
4. Performance standards: Log all known exceptions on the day reported; every open item must have an owner and due date; escalate critical issues immediately and overdue actions daily; close items only with supporting evidence or authorised confirmation.

2. Compile agreed billing support, including recce or installation records, installed quantities, acknowledgements and client acceptance where required; reconcile them with Operations and Finance.

4. Performance standards: Ensure every submitted report and completion record is traceable to its store and source; provide billing documentation by the agreed deadline; flag missing approvals explicitly; use authorised access and sharing channels for all client data.

**I . MIS analysis and reporting improvement**

1. Prepare dashboards showing planned versus actual progress, pending stores, ageing, rework, documentation gaps and reporting compliance by vendor or internal team.
2. Analyse recurring delays and data errors; highlight actionable trends and recommend improvements to collection methods, templates and reporting controls.
3. Use Excel or approved tools to reduce manual duplication; check formulas, filters and dashboard totals before release and document changes to reporting logic.

Performance standards: Provide weekly analysis and a monthly consolidated dashboard by agreed dates; reconcile every dashboard to the master tracker; explain material variances and identify action owners; review recurring errors monthly and track corrective actions.

Ability to prepare clear PowerPoint or PDF reports, organise photographic evidence, manage large store databases and work with shared folders or client portals. Power Query and Power BI are desirable. Ability to read basic recce sheets, measurements and installation checklists without assuming technical approval authority.

Attention to detail; analytical thinking; clear written and spoken communication; client service orientation; persistent follow-up; planning and prioritisation; ownership; teamwork; integrity and confidentiality.
